text: まいにち　おおくの　ひとたちが　くようの　ために　おとずれている。
note: くよう (kuyō) is a Buddhist memorial rite: offerings and prayers made for the repose of the dead. The English "pay their respects" drops the religious sense.
claim: Kuyō (供養) is a Buddhist memorial service of offerings and prayers for the dead.
